# Filter for irregular galaxies and spiral galaxies
irregular_df = df[df['object type'] == 'irregular galaxy']
spiral_df = df[df['object type'] == 'spiral galaxy']

# Calculate the mean apparent magnitude for each type
irregular_mean = irregular_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()
spiral_mean = spiral_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()

# Check if irregular galaxy mean is exactly 2.1 more than spiral galaxy mean
answer = (irregular_mean - spiral_mean) == 2.1
